priorities: T-019 fast live dictation on existing normal keyboard microphone
T-020 opt-in meeting recording after stable dictation

mechanisms.sharedAudio: Single AVAudioEngine capture and 16kHz accumulator; do not create a second microphone tap
mechanisms.model: Use the already-downloaded Qwen3-ASR 1.7B sherpa-onnx-compatible ONNX model; benchmark the pinned offline recognizer instead of assuming native streaming support
mechanisms.speed: Short provisional windows for normal keyboard; 5-10-second transcript updates for Meeting Record
mechanisms.hostInsert: Session- and document-bound marked-text preview where supported, safe fallback, final reconciliation exactly once
mechanisms.pipeline: Keep existing translation, cleanup, AI, cancellation, App Group, SideStore and host boundaries intact
mechanisms.liveOutput: Show original recognized words as quickly as device performance permits; translation/correction can finish later
mechanisms.privacy: Offline audio and transcripts, explicit recording consent, clear Stop/Cancel; no raw host typing or external upload

defaultKeyboardLiveDictation.entry: Existing microphone in the normal keyboard
acceptance: Measure real iPhone first-text delay and sustained updates before promising Apple-like latency
No duplicate committed text on finalization; no editing an unrelated host field
Preserve old batch dictation as fallback for model unavailability or unsafe host behavior
Yue/English/German code-switch and Cantonese orthography verified
Recording never stalls during decoding or OS background interruptions

meetingRecord.recordingUserExperience: One continuous visible recording even while audio files rotate

storageContract.privacy: On-device only; group-level retention, delete and export

meetingRecord.segmentRule: At exact boundaries close the preceding segment and start the next; do not create an empty 9th part on Stop at exactly 120 minutes
meetingRecord.transcriptionRule: Continue decoding while audio is captured; if model lags, preserve audio and mark pending output instead of blocking capture
meetingRecord.combinedTranscriptRule: Combine ordered segment transcriptions with global timestamps; resolve overlap at boundaries; preserve uncertain text without destructive edits
meetingRecord.recoveryRule: Make interruptions and actual audio gaps explicit; preserve all completed parts even if the final transcript has not finished
acceptance: Two hours -> 8 ordered 15-minute audio parts under one meeting
Transcript updates every 5-10 seconds when measured hardware throughput permits
One meeting transcript can be viewed/exported with all parts; no orphaned files after retention
A successful build is not proof of iPhone microphone, background decoding or storage reliability

fastImplementation: Qwen recognizer per-window RTF on actual device
Single ASR coordinator in host app
Host document ownership and final insertion tests
meetingImplementation: T-019 accepted or separately verified ASR chunking
Sample-exact file rotation and atomic manifest
2-hour battery, thermal, storage and interruption validation

deferred: Any claim of native streaming in the current sherpa-onnx Qwen model
historicalNote: Original v1 design was planned only. User has since distinguished fast keyboard dictation from slower meeting transcript updates and specified 15-minute audio file rotation.
